svg.text: Figure 8. Tactical DDD Domain Model with Isolated Aggregates and Explicit Consistency Boundaries
Erasmus Mobility Platform (EMP) — Core Aggregate Roots, Internal Entities, Value Objects and Shared Kernel

g.text: Invariant rule: AcademicPeriod enforces (endDate >= startDate). ECTSCredits enforces (value > 0).
+ addTableALine(code: String, title: String, ects: ECTSCredits, term: String): void
+ addTableBLine(code: String, title: String, ects: ECTSCredits, term: String): void
+ validateEctsBalance(): boolean [Invariant: Σ A == Σ B >= 30]
[Aggregate Boundary: Mutating course lines directly outside this root is forbidden]
1. ECTS Balance Invariant: sum(tableALines.credits) == sum(tableBLines.credits) >= 30.00 ECTS per study semester.
2. Cascade Cancellation Invariant: Invoking LearningAgreement.cancel() transitions status to CANCELLED atomically.
3. Encapsulation: External packages cannot modify CourseLineTableA or CourseLineTableB directly; all mutations traverse root methods.
4. Tripartite Seal: Submissions lock lines from uncoordinated edits; faculty approval stamps contract before host transmission.
